newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait share index edges up in easy trade week.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait share index edges up in easy trade week.

text.p: Kuwait's share index edged up 0.5 percent in slightly firmer trade in the week to Wednesday compared to the previous week.
The index finished the week at 2,332.3 points with losers leading gainers 28-18. Twenty-one shares did not change.

The daily average for value of traded shares rose to 39 million dinars from 37 million. Volume rose to a daily average of 134 million shares from 119.4 million, Kuwait Stock Exchange (KSE) figures released on Thursday show.
Investment firms were the most active sector in terms of traded value with 82 million dinars, followed by real estate firms with 45 million and banks with 29 million.
Investment Projects, International Financial Advisors IFIN.KW, United Realty, Kuwait Real Estate and Commercial Bank, were among the most active shares.
Only nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Oman and Kuwait -- can trade on the exchange. Foreign residents can invest in mutual funds.
